blocos.titulo: The typical mistake of English speakers
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: The costliest mistake is copying the English “that” and always using the same word (der for everything, or dass): die Frau, dass ich kenne. The second mistake is forgetting the case: saying der Mann, der ich kenne when the man is the object (den). The third is leaving the verb in the middle: das Buch, das ich muss lesen. STEP 2: Reread the table and say each correct sentence out loud before looking at the reason.

blocos.texto: Can I do it yet? I describe an object with das ich …, der …, die …. · I choose between der and den by looking at the function. · I put in the commas and the verb at the end.
